A '''copper boots''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. It gives 1 armor and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/copper/boots</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 1 armor. The vanilla item gives 1 armor with 143 durability.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.10|Undead wearing copper armor are immune to [[Warding]].}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Copper can no longer be smelted in an oven; it needs a mud kiln or blast furnace.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The blast furnace recipe changed and diamonds now drop raw, which the release notes describe as extending the copper and iron ages.}}
}}
